title: GOV-0018: registry entries carry a digest placeholder (GENERATED_AT_RELEASE) that nothing generates or checks
problem:
## Observed (measured 2026-08-28, branch wp/BADF-WP-0030-g01-contract)
```
badf/skill-registry.json:    "digest": "GENERATED_AT_RELEASE"     (badf-delivery)
```
`grep -n GENERATED_AT_RELEASE badf/*.json` shows the placeholder in the skill registry; `grep -n digest scripts/badf_gate.py` shows the gate never compares a registry `digest` to the source it names. `docs/07-skills-governance.md` makes `ACTIVE` mean "pinned version/digest in `badf/skill-registry.json`" — a placeholder cannot pin anything. PR #44 copied the convention for `badf-prd`; BADF-WP-0030 writes a real sha256 for its entry, which leaves the two entries inconsistent until this is fixed.

## Expected
Every registry entry's `digest` is the sha256 of the source it names, and `repo` refuses a mismatch (a skill edited without its registry re-pinned is drift twice over: lockfile and registry). `GENERATED_AT_RELEASE` is refused as a value.

## Proposed work package
Patch tier: compute the digest for `badf-delivery`; `validate_repo` checks `digest == sha256(source)` for every entry; test + mutation.
